subject: Your PayPal account has been limited
body_text:
Hello,

We noticed unusual activity in your PayPal account. We have temporarily limited your account until you confirm your identity.

To restore full access, please confirm your information at: https://paypa1-secure.com/confirm?id=8834

Failure to confirm within 48 hours will result in permanent account suspension.

Thanks,
PayPal Team

Note: This email was sent to paypal_user@gmail.com
